data: Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE) has released the notification for Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET) September Examination 2026. Interested candidates can apply online before 10 June 2026.

Important Dates:
• Application Start: 11 May 2026
• Last Date: 10 June 2026
• Fee Payment Last Date: 10 June 2026
• Correction Date: 15 – 18 June 2026
• Exam Date: 06 September 2026
• Admit Card: Before Exam

Application Fee:
• Paper-I General/OBC: ₹1000
• Paper-I SC/ST/PWD: ₹500
• Both Papers General/OBC: ₹1200
• Both Papers SC/ST/PWD: ₹600

Age Limit:
• No Age Limit
• Candidates should check official notification for complete details.

Eligibility:
• Level-1 (Class 1-5): 12th Pass with D.El.Ed / JBT / B.El.Ed / D.Ed qualification
• Level-2 (Class 6-8): Graduation Degree with B.Ed or B.El.Ed qualification
